title: Microduck wiring — the Dynamixel daisy chain, the HAT harness, battery and camera

host_power.note: 5 V arrives on 40-pin pins 2/4 from the HAT ([brief] §5.1; docs §9 'battery → banana contact PCB → HAT → 40-pin (5 V to Radxa)'); the HAT's regulator is CANNOT DETERMINE.

nodes.label: battery
nodes.note: NP-F550 pack in the trunk cradle (placements.json row 6, world (-36.0, 0, 116.1) mm); its contacts meet the banana contact PCB, which is a passive board with no electrical record — folded into the battery->HAT cable row (cables.json).

nodes.label: hat
nodes.note: On the Radxa's 40-pin header (board-to-board, no cable). Pin identifiers hdrN_* are the 40-pin numbers from part:radxa-zero-3w header_40pin (UART2_M0 8/10 settled by the Radxa wiki; I2C3_M0 3/5 from i2c3.dts; I2S3 M0 pins are THIS FILE's assertion — the M1 mux is also on the header and the dts pinctrl was not read). HAT mesh placement origin world (60.0, 29.0, 262.6) mm, placements.json row 45.

nodes.label: imu200
nodes.note: imu_to_dxl v2, bus ID 200, trunk_base; MJCF imu site world (-21, 0, 105.3) mm. The chain BRANCHES here (head string in, left leg out, right leg out) — needs >= 3 bus connectors on this board, which is CANNOT DETERMINE.

nodes.label: tof
nodes.note: On the HAT's Stemma J5 (JST-SH 4-pin, 1 mm) — the same I2C3 nets as the codec (0x18) and the dormant BMI088 (0x19/0x68); ToF at 0x29. MJCF tof site world (81.4, 22.4, 249.1) mm.

nodes.label: speaker
nodes.note: 35x25x7 box speaker, placements.json row 52, mesh origin world (-17.9, -16.8, 245.6) mm, in the head. Whether the codec drives it directly or through an amplifier on the HAT: CANNOT DETERMINE.

nodes.label: mic
nodes.note: transducer, position and connector CANNOT DETERMINE; no mesh in the MJCF, so no length can be measured — the cable row carries null, not a guess.

nodes.label: camera
nodes.note: IMX219 board behind the M12 lens, upside down (rotation 180 in the encoder). Pin identifiers csi_J7_pN_* are the Radxa's 22-pin MIPI CSI table (part:radxa-zero-3w). Camera site world (81.4, 0, 251.1) and the Radxa at (68.1, 0, 251.05): SAME body jaw_soft — the ribbon crosses no joint.

external.csi_J7_p22_VCC_3V3: VCC_3V3 on MIPI CSI pin 22 is the Radxa's own 3.3 V rail ([wiki] 22-pin table, part:radxa-zero-3w), i.e. the host sources it; a bare host cannot state a provision here, so it is asserted.
